independent-reverse-routing-tree.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: urgent
  group_by: [cluster, alertname]
  group_wait: 400ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1000ms
  routes:
  - receiver: standard
    matchers: ['severity="warning"']
  - receiver: fallback
    matchers: ['severity!="critical"', 'severity!="warning"']
receivers:
- name: fallback
  webhook_configs: [{url: 'http://127.0.0.1:0/fallback', send_resolved: true}]
- name: standard
  webhook_configs: [{url: 'http://127.0.0.1:0/standard', send_resolved: true}]
- name: urgent
  webhook_configs: [{url: 'http://127.0.0.1:0/urgent', send_resolved: true}]

explicit-equivalent-child-interval.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: fallback
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - cluster
  group_wait: 400ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1s
  routes:
  - receiver: urgent
    matchers:
    - severity="critical"
    group_interval: 200ms
  - receiver: standard
    matchers:
    - severity="warning"
    group_interval: 200ms
receivers:
- name: urgent
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/urgent
    send_resolved: true
- name: standard
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/standard
    send_resolved: true
- name: fallback
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/fallback
    send_resolved: true
